environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 application deployed as AWS Lambda behind API Gateway (HTTP API type) with a custom domain. The API Gateway endpoint is publicly accessible at api.example.com. No WAF is attached. The Lambda function URL is also enabled as a fallback. CloudFront distribution exists but is configured in monitoring-only mode (report-uri for CSP) and does not enforce signed URLs on this origin. API Gateway has no request validation or transformation templates applied.
